rules.basis: The ESF controller sheet states the PV open-circuit limit, 150 to 250 V, with the two words run together.
The ESF controller sheet states 'Charge rated current', 40 to 100 A; the M48120 inverter-charger sheet states its MPPT charger's current, 120 A.
The ESF controller sheet states the PV input power per system voltage, 520 to 5200 W; the bank voltage is read off the name.
The LFP-M48 battery sheet states 'Nominal voltage' as 51.2 V; its 'Battery Voltage' of 48 V is the system class and is not read.
The LFP-M48 battery sheet states 'Rated Charge Current', 50 or 100 A, as the pack's continuous charge rating.
The LFP-M48 battery sheet states 'Rated Discharge Current', 100 A, beside a higher 'Peak Discharge Current': the continuous rating.
